# Saved replies

## Goal
Agents can save a reply and reuse it.

## Work units
### U1: Saved reply storage
- Depends on: none
- Covers: AC1
Model, migration and API for saved replies.

### U2: Picker UI
- Depends on: U1
- Covers: AC2, AC3
The picker in the composer.

## Out of scope
- Sharing replies between users.
